decisions.proposed_text: Chỉ rút gọn sự kiện chính
decisions.reason: The current setting label is unnecessarily wide; the compact form keeps the distinction that only main scenario events are shortened.

decisions.proposed_text: Chỉ rút gọn sự kiện Uma
decisions.reason: The full franchise noun and training wording make the paired setting much wider than necessary; compact canonical 'Uma' preserves the event category.

decisions.proposed_text: Đăng ký đua sau {0} lượt
decisions.reason: The shorter status preserves the exact {0}-turn wait before race registration while removing redundant helper wording.

decisions.proposed_text: Không có cuộc đua khả dụng
decisions.reason: The current wording is literal and very wide; 'khả dụng' naturally preserves that no race can currently be challenged/entered.

decisions.proposed_text: Từ {0}, <color=#FF6D26>xuất hiện</color> khi tập
decisions.reason: The compact wording preserves the starting point, training context, placeholder, and color tag while cutting substantial width.

decisions.proposed_text: Đua đặt lịch đang diễn ra
decisions.reason: The current phrase is verbose; the compact status keeps that the scheduled race is now underway.

decisions.proposed_text: <atlas=PreIn sprite=utx_ico_notice_00/> Còn {0} lượt đến hạn
decisions.reason: The SingleMode context makes the training deadline implicit; the shorter warning preserves the remaining-turn mechanic plus the atlas tag and placeholder.

decisions.proposed_text: Không thể dự đua mục tiêu
decisions.reason: Using the compact race verb removes redundant wording while preserving the inability to enter the target race.

decisions.proposed_text: Thiếu fan cho đua mục tiêu
decisions.reason: The shorter status preserves that the target race's fan requirement is not met without the current verbose negative construction.

decisions.proposed_text: Chưa đủ lần đạt mục tiêu
decisions.reason: The compact wording keeps the insufficient objective-completion-count meaning and removes unnecessary verbal padding.

decisions.proposed_text: Không tăng khi Tâm trạng Tuyệt hảo
decisions.reason: The current sentence repeats helper words around the mood state; the compact form preserves the no-increase condition and existing terminology.

decisions.proposed_text: Không đặt lịch khi có đua mục tiêu
decisions.reason: The direct restriction is much narrower and preserves that scheduling is unavailable on turns containing a target race.

decisions.proposed_text: Đua mục tiêu do sự kiện quyết định
decisions.reason: The compact passive relationship preserves that the target race is determined through an event while removing the verbose full phrase.

decisions.proposed_text: Sao chép sang bộ bài khác
decisions.reason: The source action is clear but the exact control type is not; the current deck is already implicit, so removing 'bộ bài này' keeps the copy action intact and narrower.

decisions.proposed_text: <color=#{0}>Ưu tiên Center</color>
decisions.reason: This is a colored path label, but the exact layout is not exposed; the path context makes 'Con đường' redundant while 'Ưu tiên Center' preserves the distinguishing concept and exact color tag.

decisions.proposed_text: <color=#{0}>Uma nổi tiếng</color>
decisions.reason: The colored path context makes 'Con đường' redundant; compact canonical 'Uma' preserves the famous-Uma route distinction and the exact color tag.

decisions.proposed_text: Dự đua ở hạng nổi tiếng {0}
decisions.reason: The shorter race-entry wording retains that {0} is the popularity rank at entry while removing the verbose 'độ nổi tiếng' construction.

decisions.proposed_text: Không thể chọn thẻ trùng
decisions.reason: The support-card selection context makes the full noun redundant; the compact canonical micro form preserves the duplicate-card restriction.

decisions.proposed_text: Thắng 1 cuộc đua Pre-OP
decisions.reason: The objective only requires a win in any one Pre-OP race; the compact mission-style wording preserves that requirement with far less width.

decisions.proposed_text: Thắng 1 cuộc đua OP
decisions.reason: The objective only requires a win in any one OP race; the compact mission-style wording preserves that requirement with far less width.
